model_output.verdict: A mid-market account executive with a strong sales year and a few questions about quota and earlier performance.
write_up: Your resume tells a clear story: you moved from sales development into a mid-market account executive role at Crestview HR Cloud, selling HR software. A recruiter can see the revenue you closed and the companies you sell to. The main question is how your sales results compare across periods.
The payroll partner line is a strong model: it names what you built, who was involved and the deals it sourced. Your promotion and tools also reinforce the sales story, without crowding out the work.
Start with the 2025 sales line. Add your actual quota and, if you have it, performance from another period. Then make your part in demos and your SDR results a little more concrete.

cards.line: - Closed $1.1M in new annual recurring revenue in 2025, 108% of quota
cards.cannot_tell: The revenue and attainment are useful, but the actual quota isn't stated. Another period of performance would also show whether the 2025 result held beyond one year.
cards.example: Closed $1.1M in new annual recurring revenue in 2025, 108% of a [quota] quota; closed [revenue] against a [quota] quota in [period]
cards.question: What was your 2025 quota, and what were your revenue and quota for another period?

cards.line: - Work with solutions engineers on demos and security reviews
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see who you work with, but not what you do during the demos and security reviews. Your part matters in a full-cycle sales role.
cards.example: Work with solutions engineers on demos and security reviews, [what you do]
cards.question: What do you handle in the demos and security reviews?

cards.line: - Booked meetings for three account executives
cards.cannot_tell: The three account executives give the work context, but the number of meetings isn't there. That would help show your production as an SDR.
cards.example: Booked [number] meetings for three account executives in [time period]
cards.question: How many meetings did you book, and over what period?

cards.line: - Top SDR in two quarters
cards.cannot_tell: Being the top SDR is worth keeping. The resume doesn't say what it was based on or who you were compared with.
cards.example: Top SDR in two quarters based on [metric] among [comparison group]
cards.question: What metric earned you the top SDR designation, and which group was ranked?

cards.line: - Built a referral program with two payroll partners that sourced 9 deals
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as the model for the rest. It gives a recruiter a concrete program and a count of the deals it sourced.

fit.why: Your headline and current Crestview role both point to mid-market HR software sales.
fit.level: mid-level, full-cycle account executive promoted from SDR
fit.note: Your experience points toward account executive roles selling software to mid-market companies. The SDR promotion and payroll partner program give you useful examples to build on.
